card.name: Middle digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, after the leading digits and before the last ones. It is seen in temperatures, ranges, lab cutoffs and tables.

modes.label: Temperatures
modes.description: Digit inside a fever value in °F or °C.

modes.label: Ranges and cutoffs
modes.description: Digit inside a number in a range or lab threshold.
modes.example: The median time to onset of VTEs was 84 days (range: 6 to 7<<7>>7).

modes.label: Table values
modes.description: Digit inside numbers in a table of values.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a longer number, such as a temperature or a range limit.
